description: This file defines API client functions for interacting with a backend server, including functions for health checks, user management, session tracking, deployments, and costs. It exports functions for making HTTP requests using axios, and includes internal helper functions for URL joining and response normalization.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Safely concatenates base URL and path, handling trailing and leading slashes.

methods.name: normalizeListResponse
methods.description: Normalizes API list responses to extract items, total count, and metadata.
